answer: A useful defense is proof of sustained work tied to a single identity: before an agent can join the market, it must build a long, verifiable history, like keeping a steady pulse of honest transactions over weeks. A newcomer that appears at dawn with no record is quarantined to a small island of low-value trades until its behavior is proven. Creating many fake identities then costs weeks of real work each, so a Sybil attacker pays far more than the value they can extract.
